spans.text: At one time the Buddha was staying in the land of the Kurus, near the Kuru town named Kammāsadamma, on a grass mat in the fire chamber of a brahmin of the Bhāradvāja clan.

entries.task_id: because|heavenly|sensual pleasures are better than human sensual pleasures
entries.description: Because heavenly sensual pleasures are better than human sensual pleasures
entries.subject: Because
entries.object: sensual pleasures are better than human sensual pleasures

spans.text: Because heavenly sensual pleasures are better than human sensual pleasures.”

Having practiced good conduct by way of body, speech, and mind, when their body breaks up, after death, they’d be reborn in a good place, a heavenly realm, in the company of the gods of the thirty-three.
There they’d amuse themselves in the Garden of Delight, escorted by a band of nymphs, supplied and provided with the five kinds of heavenly sensual stimulation.

Would that god—amusing themselves in the Garden of Delight, escorted by a band of nymphs, supplied and provided with the five kinds of heavenly sensual stimulation—envy that householder or householder’s child their five kinds of human sensual stimulation, or return to human sensual pleasures?”
